value.rationale: Finite precision in two reported expectation values is the natural robust numerical-information problem. The formula exactly converts a nonlinear pair-of-pure-states worst case into an efficiently interpretable penalized spectral-spread optimization, including the sharp choice of coefficients. The rank-rigidity theorem shows mixed-state relaxation is exact precisely under the two-observable constraint budget, while a qubit example exhibits a genuine nonlinear active-to-saturated transition. The statement is not just the previous zero-error distance calculation or a relabelled parameter.
